data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'shanti' meaning peace, calmness and tranquility. In Hindu mythology, Shaant is a name given to gods, goddesses and heroes who embody peace and serenity. The name Shaant carries the meaning “Peaceful, Tranquil” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shaant usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful, tranquil and live with faith, good character and purpose.
